bias_targets.methodology: Proposes using crowdsourced human-computation games (e.g., 'Guess Who?', 'Beat the Banker') where players adversarially probe models with freeform text or modified demographic features to surface implicit biases related to sex and gender.

Proposes networked adversarial games to evaluate and surface discriminatory behavior in machine learning models by altering demographic features or inputs to identify disparities across race or skin tone.
Proposes Human-vs-AI text-guessing games to identify if underlying models (such as those based on word embeddings) incorrectly rely on implicit occupational stereotypes to make predictions.
Proposes 'Beat the Banker', a game where players tweak hypothetical demographic features to see if changing sensitive attributes alters an AI model's predicted probability of loan repayment.
